name: openatc
description: Browser-based ATC simulator with a server-authoritative, deterministic simulation engine.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @openatc/server" "npm run dev -w @openatc/web"
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/shared && tsc -p packages/airport-data && tsc -p packages/sim-engine && tsc -p packages/phraseology && tsc -p packages/voice && tsc -p apps/server && tsc -p apps/web
